semiconductor_relevance: High — ESOL is a key player in the semiconductor industry as the only domestic manufacturer of EUV equipment in South Korea, focusing on measurement and inspection equipment for EUV masks.
summary: ESOL specializes in the production and sale of EUV measurement and inspection equipment, catering to the semiconductor industry's stringent requirements. Their product portfolio includes lithography systems for wafer-level packaging, bumping, and 3D interconnect aligners, as well as nanotechnology tools and simulation software.

regional_presence.Korea: ESOL is the only domestic manufacturer of EUV equipment in South Korea, indicating a significant manufacturing presence there.
